text:
Anna Chen: Morning handoff — quick summary of the overnight run and current state. ops-bot paged us around 02:12 UTC for a regional 503 surge affecting embed-rendering workers (eu-west). We ran canary fallback to the small-quant model which kept latency for P95 customers under control but increased unit cost. Logs + short timeline below.

ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INCIDENT-2026-0421-114 (503 surge - eu-west embeddings). PagerDuty: primary alerting to Anna Chen, secondary Jamal Ortiz.

Anna Chen: Timeline TL;DR — 02:12 pager, 02:20 identified KV cache pressure on embed workers (memory churn), 02:35 rolled a targeted autoscaler policy to reduce burst churn, 03:00 canary to q4-small quant model for eu-west, 03:40 latency stabilized ~ P95 780ms (goal 1s). No customer-facing error rate above 0.6% after fallback.

Jamal Ortiz: Confirming — eviction rates on the redis shard were spiking, and we also saw a few pods OOMkilling after GC pauses. Root cause likely a combination of a bad request spike (large batch embeddings) + autoscaler not reacting fast enough.

Sara Mitchell: Metrics I watched: redis.evictions/s spiked to 420/s at 02:18, kube OOMKills rose to 3 nodes in 02:22-02:30 window. I added a temporary throttle rule on the embeddings route (rate-limit <= 20 rps per tenant) at 02:28 to slow the incoming spike. That dropped eviction pressure by 02:34.

Lucas Rivera: For the record, the canary used model=q4-small-2026-03, routing policy: region eu-west -> canary variant. Applied via console rollout id roll_kk73 at 02:59. infra-deploy-bot confirmed rollout success.

infra-deploy-bot: rollout roll_kk73 succeeded on 12/12 hosts (02:59 UTC).

Anna Chen: Current status — Incident is mitigated, services in eu-west are on canary model, rate-limits remain applied. No active pages expected but leaving the thread open for handoff.

Jamal Ortiz: Coverage note — I'm primary until 11:00 UTC, but I need to step out at 09:15 for a meeting. Can Sara be primary during 09:15-11:00? I'm not fully sure if a full handover is needed because things are stable, but we should confirm.

Sara Mitchell: I can cover 09:15-11:00 as acting primary. Quick checklist for taking over: 1) check ops-dashboard > embeddings > eu-west 2) confirm rate-limit rules still in place 3) ensure canary rollout remains active 4) be ready to revert to main model if error rate creeps above 1.0%.

Anna Chen: Good. Lucas — can you add a short runbook pointer to the thread and leave the exact revert command here? Saves time if we need to flip.

Lucas Rivera: Put the snippet below (use from console or kubectl depending on your access).

Lucas Rivera: ```
# revert model routing for eu-west to main model
# console: Redwood Console > Model Rollouts > roll_kk73 > revert
# kubectl (if console unreachable):
kubectl -n inference patch rollout roll_kk73 --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/state","value":"rollback"}]'
# watch: kubectl -n inference get pods -l rollout=roll_kk73 -w
```

Jamal Ortiz: Thanks. Also note: keep an eye on cost-burn metrics while canary is live; cost per 1k tokens rose ~24% during the canary period. Finance ping scheduled if it stays >15% delta for more than 6 hours.

Anna Chen: Action items before handoff: 
- Jamal: document any tenant IDs that hit rate-limit (please paste list in this thread).
- Sara: accept primary for 09:15-11:00 and run the quick checklist above at takeover.
- Lucas: pin the rollback snippet in console and add a 1-line summary in the runbook (ops/doc/embeddings-eu-west.md).
- Anna: will monitor for another hour, then sign out by 12:00 UTC.

Jamal Ortiz: Tenant IDs that were throttled in the spike: tenant_88, tenant_omega, tenant-searchsvc (partial). Pushed logs to /ops/incident-2026-0421-114/logs.

Sara Mitchell: Accepted, I'll be primary 09:15-11:00. I'll do the initial check at 09:10 and post status here.

ops-bot: REMINDER scheduled: 09:05 UTC — handover check.

Anna Chen: Notes for next shift: possible follow-ups — evaluate autoscaler policy to react to short spikes better (current cooldown too long), consider prefix caching for large batch tenants, and add an alert for redis.evictions/s > 200 for >2min.

Lucas Rivera: I've added the alert draft to monitoring repo: https://internal.redwood/mon/alerts#redis-evictions-eu-west and updated runbook ops/doc/embeddings-eu-west.md with rollback snippet.

Sara Mitchell: 09:11 UTC takeover check — eu-west metrics green, rate limits in place, no new OOMs in last 50m. Continuing monitoring.

Anna Chen: Closing notes: Incident marked MITIGATED. If anything changes, page primary. Otherwise I'll post a short post-incident note after 12:00 with costs and follow-up items. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
